source: Bambu: BambuStudio master da8b44e + OrcaSlicer 03377a0 BBL profiles. Prusa/Creality/Elegoo/Anycubic/QIDI/Sovol/Voron: OrcaSlicer 2457173 (2026-10-20) 0.4 mm machine profiles (inherits resolved); park Y from the native machine_end_gcode; toolhead body height/footprint are app estimates - see PRINTER_DB_SOURCES.md | schema v5: vendors + no_park

verified_gcode.label: verified
verified_gcode.description: Confirmed in a real sliced file on hardware

end_gcode_park.label: from end gcode
end_gcode_park.description: Position used by the official machine_end_gcode (firmware-accepted), not yet exercised by an ejection

estimate.label: estimated
estimate.description: Not confirmed - verify on hardware before unattended use

no_park.label: no park zone
no_park.description: No rear park in the vendor end gcode - the pusher starts at the rear edge of the printable area

verified.label: Verified
verified.description: End-to-end verified on this model (native gcode analyzed, user-confirmed mechanics)

expected.label: Expected
expected.description: Identical mechanics (bedslinger, same toolhead family) - expected to work, not physically tested

needs-test.label: Needs a test print
needs-test.description: Mechanism plausible (the toolhead pushes via its own motion instead of bed motion) but NOT verified: firmware Y-limits behind plate, enclosed-chamber cooldown and front clearance must be checked on the real machine
